description: List the signed-in merchant's recent website edits made through OnHand, newest first (up to 10): edit_id, prompt (the owner's own request), page, applied_at, undone and undoable; or error, message. An edit whose outcome SiteMe has not confirmed yet appears once it is settled. Use it to let the owner pick an edit for prepare_undo_website_edit. Requires company:read; the account selects the business. Read-only.
name: list_website_edits
title: List my website edits
